name: Anyone Can Cook
summary: An illegible recipe appears to describe a meat dish, and you suspect ogre writing. Find an ogre who can read it.

sections.title: A Strange Recipe
sections.body: The recipe is written in a language you cannot read, and its subject seems to be a meat dish. Ogre is your best guess, given where it came from and what it describes. You hope to find an ogre who can translate it.

faq.answer: It appears to be for some sort of meat dish.

faq.q: What language is the recipe written in?
faq.answer: You do not understand the language. Ogre is your best guess.
You are looking for an ogre who can read it.
Skonk is an ogre who is listening for the recipe.

angles.text: As a cook, you have a reason to wonder what sort of meat dish the illegible recipe describes.

attribution: In-game quest text: Anyone Can Cook
